label: axillary
definition: A positional quality inhering in a plant structure by virtue of its arising in an axil, the upper angle between a leaf or bract and the stem that bears it.
source_words: axillary (NCVC 54, Collenette 3)

label: leaf-opposed
definition: A positional quality inhering in a plant structure by virtue of its arising from the stem on the side opposite the point of attachment of a leaf.
source_words: leaf-opposed (4)

label: basal
definition: A positional quality inhering in a plant structure by virtue of its arising at or near the base of its supporting stem or shoot system.
source_words: basal (19)

label: solitary
definition: A spatial pattern quality inhering in a plant structure by virtue of its being borne individually at a particular attachment site rather than together with other structures of the same kind at that site.
source_words: solitary (NCVC 24, Collenette 8)

label: paired
definition: A spatial pattern quality inhering in a plant structure by virtue of its being borne together with one other structure of the same kind as a pair at a common node or closely associated attachment sites.
source_words: paired / in pairs (8)

label: rosulate
definition: A spatial pattern quality inhering in a leaf or shoot system by virtue of the leaf belonging to, or the shoot system bearing, a dense radiating cluster of leaves on a shortened axis.
source_words: rosette (14)

label: capitate
definition: An aggregated quality inhering in an inflorescence or flower by virtue of its flowers forming, or the flower belonging to, a compact head-like cluster on a shortened inflorescence axis.
source_words: head (95)

label: caespitose
definition: An aggregated quality inhering in a whole plant or shoot system by virtue of its stems or shoots growing close together in a dense tuft or clump from the base.
source_words: tufted (34)

label: creeping
definition: A prostrate quality inhering in a stem or plant by virtue of its growing along the surface of the ground and rooting at the nodes.
source_words: creeping (9)

label: mat-forming
definition: A shape quality inhering in a plant by virtue of its growing low and spreading into a dense, flat mat over the ground.
source_words: mat-forming (13)

label: twiggy
definition: A branched quality inhering in a whole plant or shoot by virtue of its bearing numerous slender, fine branches.
source_words: twiggy (28)

label: leafy
definition: A structural quality inhering in a whole plant or shoot by virtue of its bearing well-developed foliage leaves along its axes.
source_words: leafy (552)

label: subsessile
definition: An attachment quality inhering in a plant structure by virtue of its being attached by a very short stalk, so that it is almost sessile.
source_words: subsessile (14)

label: bipinnate
definition: A pinnate quality inhering in a compound leaf by virtue of its primary divisions (pinnae) being themselves pinnate.
source_words: bipinnate (3)

label: unisexual
definition: A phenotypic sex quality inhering in a flower by virtue of its having either functional stamens or functional carpels, but not both.
source_words: unisexual (7)

label: sweet-scented
definition: An odorous quality inhering in a plant structure by virtue of its having a sweet, pleasant odour.
source_words: sweet (7)

label: spicy-scented
definition: An odorous quality inhering in a plant structure by virtue of its having a pungent, spicy odour.
source_words: spicy (5)

label: musty-smelling
definition: An odorous quality inhering in a plant structure by virtue of its having a stale, mouldy odour.
source_words: musty (3)

label: sour-smelling
definition: An odorous quality inhering in a plant structure by virtue of its having a sharp, acid odour.
source_words: sour (24)

label: foetid
definition: An odorous quality inhering in a plant structure by virtue of its having an unpleasant, offensive odour.
source_words: foetid (2)

label: exfoliating
definition: A texture quality inhering in bark, another surface tissue, or a plant axis bearing that tissue by virtue of its outer layers peeling or shedding in sheets, strips, plates or flakes.
source_words: peeling (9)

label: fissured
definition: A texture quality inhering in bark, another surface, or a plant axis bearing that surface by virtue of its being marked by deep cracks or clefts.
source_words: fissured (6)

label: petiolate
definition: An attachment quality inhering in a leaf by virtue of its being attached to its supporting shoot axis by a petiole.
source_words: petiolate (NCVC rule Q58 read it as petiole present)

label: ovate
definition: A 2-D shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's outline being egg-shaped, entirely convex and broadest below the middle, towards the base.
source_words: ovate (leaf, petal, sepal, bract); temporary class for PATO:0104368 (pato-ontology/pato#627)

label: obovoid
definition: A spheroid quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being egg-shaped and broadest above the middle, with the narrow end towards the base.
source_words: obovoid (fruit, seed, ovary); temporary class for PATO:0104369 (pato-ontology/pato#627)

label: fibrous
